slot_note: second root of task172 (batch 1 re-root, 2026-10-31): v1's work-permit renewal quote retired by the batch audit (no survivor anatomy); a new client domain (biomedical-clinical-research), world and dataset under the same objective
niche: an academic cancer trials unit's interim review of a charity-funded phase 3 immunotherapy trial, where the funder's agreement sets three continuation bands on the conditional power of the final progression-free survival analysis, read with each arm's progression over the follow-up still to come
answer: Continue TALON-2 to its final analysis at 330 events as planned (Schedule 2 band C): the conditional power is 100 per cent to the nearest 10 per cent, against the band's 80 per cent
analyst_test: A strong analyst who counts the BICR-confirmed progression-free survival events the charter counts, applies the SAP's censoring table, converts the UTC randomisation times, fits the SAP's stratified Cox model (hazard ratio 0.91) and carries it into the remaining follow-up as the conditional power's single ratio files about 5 per cent, band A and a futility stop; ravolimab's arm progresses slightly faster than placebo's through the week-12 assessment and at about 0.4 times its rate from the week-18 assessment on, and most patients still at risk at the cut are past the week-12 assessment, so the events still to come run at the later ratio and the conditional power is 100 per cent to the nearest 10 per cent: band C, continue as planned.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the conditional power of an event-driven final analysis, worked inside the group-sequential machinery a data monitoring committee applies (the information fraction, the B-value, the stratified log-rank test at its final event count) from time-to-event data by arm (Kaplan-Meier curves, event rates per patient-month by assessment visit); put churn and an onboarding programme in for progression and ravolimab and there is no event-driven final analysis, no information fraction and no conditional power band, so the call has nothing to stand on.

spine.entity: one central-laboratory result for one patient at one visit

world.geography: United Kingdom (a university cancer trials unit) for a 14-country trial
world.org_type: a university cancer trials unit running a charity-funded, investigator-led phase 3 trial with an independent data monitoring committee

driver: An intervention's effect on an outcome's rate starts only some months after each unit is assigned, so a look taken while most of the observed exposure is still early reads the effect as small; the exposure still to come is mostly late exposure, where the effect is full, so the chance that the final test succeeds, computed with the effect averaged over the look, falls far below the chance the effect over the remaining exposure gives, and a stop decision taken on the first is wrong.
driver_concrete: In TALON-2 ravolimab plus gemcitabine-cisplatin and placebo plus gemcitabine-cisplatin progress at about the same rate through the week-12 assessment (rate ratio 1.34) and ravolimab's arm at about 0.38 times the other's from the week-18 assessment on; at the interim cut, with 165 BICR-confirmed events and all 450 patients randomised, most events fell in the early period, so the stratified Cox hazard ratio is 0.91 and the conditional power under it about 5 per cent (band A, stop), while the events still to come, most from patients past the week-12 assessment, give a conditional power above 99 per cent at the final analysis's 330 events (band C, continue as planned); the sample-size ratio the charter excludes gives about 54 per cent (band B).
stump: A competent solver who counts the charter's BICR-confirmed events correctly fits the stratified Cox model, carries its hazard ratio of 0.91 into the remaining follow-up and recommends stopping for futility at a conditional power of about 5 per cent; the step that lands it there is taking one ratio for the whole follow-up, when the arms run together through the week-12 assessment and ravolimab's at about 0.4 times placebo's after, so the events still to come, most from patients past the week-12 assessment, give a conditional power of 100 per cent to the nearest 10 per cent and the trial continues as planned.

differentiation.task122: task122 reads a kidney drug's chronic eGFR slope after a protocol-timed background-therapy change undoes part of the early fall, a continuous marker's slope that picks a dose; task172 reads a treatment's hazard ratio on progression over time since randomisation, nil for four months and full after, at an interim look whose observed exposure is mostly early, and the call is the conditional power of the final event-driven test.
differentiation.task309: task309 varies a retrofit's loss reduction with each storm's local gust across a record whose exposure sat in mild storms, a dose of hazard by event; task172 varies a drug's effect with each patient's own time since randomisation, so the look's exposure and the exposure still to come differ in follow-up time, not in severity, and the quantity is a sequential test's conditional power.
differentiation.task133: task133 conditions an outcome curve on units having survived to the takeover; task172 conditions nothing on survival: the hazard ratio between two randomised arms changes with follow-up time and the interim look holds mostly early follow-up.
differentiation.task123: task123 splits a meter-read total onto calendar months by how fast consumption ran inside each reading interval, a within-interval timing of a quantity; task172 has no interval to split: a randomised treatment's hazard ratio changes with each patient's time since randomisation and the interim look's exposure is mostly early follow-up, so the forward conditional power of the final test is read from the late hazard ratio.

lineage.fate: retired 2026-10-31 by the batch audit before any portal result: designed before the survivor anatomy gate, its note carries no Actor, Link or Reflex line
lineage.driver: A unit's wait runs through a scheduled step and then a review, and is cut short only when the unit's own deadline passes, after which a request settles it within days; while the step came early the deadline cut only the record's slowest tail, but the step is now scheduled so late that most units will reach their deadline first, so the forward percentile is set by each unit's deadline plus the request's few weeks, not by the step's added delay laid on the record's waits or on its stage times, and not by the record's waits as they stand.
